latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release providing authoritative aviation regulation search via the Deepsky API.

- Enables searching ICAO, FAA (14 CFR), EASA, and CASA regulations and manuals using natural-language queries—no API key required.
- Returns results with clear citations (jurisdiction, rule reference, excerpt) for regulatory compliance.
- Offers access to NOTAM Q-code interpretation, flight operations rules (Part 91/121/135), IFR/VFR requirements, fuel planning, pilot rest, EDTO/ETOPS, and cross-jurisdictional lookups.
- Supports discovery of Deepsky agent-friendly endpoints and agent skill packages.
- Provides simple Python CLI (`scripts/deepsky_search.py`) for streamlined queries and citation formatting.
